blocks.title: Choke
blocks.text: Choke moti copper taar ki coil hai jo bohat se chakkaron ke saath patli tahon wale naram lohe ke markaz (laminated soft-iron core) par qareeb qareeb lipti ho.

Choke ko aksar series RL circuit maana jata hai: bohat chhoti resistance R, zyada inductive reactance XL = 2 pi f L wale inductor ke saath series mein (Fig 17.7 e, tasveer). Lohe ke markaz ki zyada permeability ki wajah se is ki inductance bohat zyada hai. Kyunke is ki resistance na-qabil-e-zikr hai, is ka power factor (cos theta) taqreeban sifar aur current aur voltage ka phase farq taqreeban 90 darje hai, is liye amalan koi taqat hararat ban kar zaya nahi hoti.

items: Choke zyada frequency ke AC ko rokta jab ke DC aur kam frequency ke AC ko guzarne deta hai; yeh electronic circuits se zyada frequency ka shor chhaant kar saaf DC output deta hai.
Chokes switch-mode power supplies mein zaruri hain, voltage qaboo karne aur switching shor chhaantne mein madad dete hain.
Yeh na-pasandeeda radio-frequency signals ko circuits se bahar nikalne se rok kar hassas hisson ki hifazat karte hain.
Fluorescent lights mein choke tube ki gas mein discharge shuru karne ke liye zaruri waqti unchi voltage paida karta hai.
Chokes current ki tabdeeli ki sharah mehdood kar ke achanak ubhar se insulation ko nuqsan se bachate hain.

blocks.alt: Frequency ke muqable reactance ka graph. Origin se barabar barhti purple seedhi lakeer XL = 2 pi f L hai, jo zyada frequencies rokti. Teal curve jo kam frequency par bohat ooncha aur mehwar ki taraf girta hai XC = 1/(2 pi f C) hai, jo kam frequencies aur DC rokta. Note: DC (f = 0) ke liye XL = 0 aur XC la-mehdood.
blocks.caption: Frequency ke muqable inductive aur capacitive reactance (asal graph).
blocks.long_description: Inductor aur capacitor ulat bartao karte hain: inductor DC guzarta aur tez tabdeeliyon ki mukhalfat karta, jab ke capacitor DC rokta aur tez tabdeeliyan guzarne deta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Capacitor aur inductor AC aur DC ke liye mukhtalif bartao kyun karte hain? DC supply ke liye f = 0, is liye XL = 2 pi f L = 0 aur inductor conductor ki tarah kaam karta, jab ke XC = 1/(2 pi f C) = 1/0, jo la-mehdood hai: capacitor DC rokta lekin AC guzarne deta hai. (Kitab ke box mein 'AC supply jab f = 0' likha hai; murad DC supply hai.)

blocks.prompt: Choke current kam karne ke bawajood bohat kam taqat kyun zaya karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ki resistance bohat kam hai, is liye power factor taqreeban sifar (V aur I taqreeban 90 darje door); yeh current reactance se mehdood karta hai, jo tawanai hararat banane ke bajaye jama kar ke wapas karti hai.

items: Choke: laminated lohe ke markaz par bohat se chakkar; chhoti R, bari XL.
Power factor taqreeban sifar: taqreeban koi hararat nahi.
Zyada frequency ka AC rokta; istemal: filters, SMPS, RF rokna, fluorescent lamps.
